# OverCue Desktop 2.2.27 for Windows

- Update your players to OverCue firmware 0.13.1 on the Firmware page before preparing stems with this version. Earlier firmware can’t play the new stems.
- New CDJ-3000 stems use four audio files per track instead of seven, so they take less space on the USB. The players mix the instrumental and vocal pairs themselves.
- Remove unused stem files: when a USB holds stems prepared with the three extra files, the USB page offers to delete them. The stems stay and play on firmware 0.13.1 or newer.
- Checking a USB’s stems is much faster, because unchanged tracks are no longer read again.
- Normalizing volume now works on stems prepared with OverCue 2.1 or earlier. Those tracks stopped with “Unsupported stem codec”.
- Messages on the USB page take less room.
